name: Unknown batch executor unauthenticated execute(actions)
summary: EOA 0x98289e90 deployed an unverified batch executor and gave it an unlimited yvWETH allowance. Its execute((address,uint256,bytes)[]) runs arbitrary calls for any caller. An attacker's constructor had it transferFrom the owner's entire 384.667 yvWETH balance to itself, withdraw the underlying from the Yearn vault, and send the 429.21 WETH to the attacker.

loss.notes: Exact yvWETH debit from owner 0x98289e90d6fc92a8769bc892d006a2baa7705afe, valued at the vault's pricePerShare() at block 24981716 (1.118358035811806430 WETH per share, 430.1957 WETH) times the DefiLlama WETH price. The attacker's withdraw accepted maxLoss 10000 bps and realised 429.210570004163139885 WETH; the 0.985 WETH shortfall is strategy loss borne by the stolen shares and is included. No attacker input is involved.

ageReset.description: Direct, non-upgradeable 3,198-byte runtime created through the deterministic CREATE2 deployer; execute() is open from creation. The owner's later unlimited yvWETH approval only set exposure.

limitations: The executor has no verified source; the missing caller authorization is established from the execution trace, in which a contract created by the attacker in the same transaction successfully invoked execute(), rather than from source text.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age. Source-1 is a contract creation by EOA 0x6a818c673b098621e9bfb2adc80060906cf7b327. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer): its constructor 0x64c589f3ef894678e46af3b851aa08be3f40a674 CREATEs 0xcc9be93051e8ad00a70eba3df2571a18f94d5856, which CALLs executor 0x143a737bffc6414b61134f513ceed1a64390181a with selector 0x49650044 (Etherscan-labelled execute(tuple[] actions)) and three actions: yvWETH 0xa258c4606ca8206d8aa700ce2143d7db854d168c transferFrom(0x98289e90d6fc92a8769bc892d006a2baa7705afe, executor, 0x14da549c890b6db987), yvWETH withdraw(0x14da549c890b6db987, executor, 10000) (selector 0xe63697c8), and a WETH sweep to 0xcc9be930... The executor performs all three and transfers 0x17447e435d1d13193f WETH to 0xcc9be930.., which unwraps and forwards 429.210570004163139903 ETH to the attacker EOA. Neither msg.sender nor tx.origin is the owner, so execute() has no effective caller check. Approval: eth_getLogs yvWETH Approval(owner 0x98289e90.., spender executor), blocks 24900000..25100000: MaxUint256 at block 24909652 (tx 0x52b4e570..6fae) and 0 at block 25086304 (tx 0x14aa22db..0ec7, after the exploit). Earliest exercise: yvWETH Transfer logs from the owner, blocks 24909613..25100000, show four owner-initiated execute() pulls (txs 0x92884691.., 0xd8c4cbf9.., 0x135e1f11.., 0x30f5ace1.., blocks 24909660-24909714, all sent by the owner per Etherscan txlist) and then only source-1; the owner's Approval scan across all tokens (topic1 owner, topic2 executor) returns only yvWETH, and the owner's Transfer scan across all tokens shows no other executor pull. Age: eth_getCode empty at block 24909612, keccak256 0x5595d117..1659 (3198 bytes) at 24909613 and 24981716. Creation tx 0xffa51c04..f0af (tx index 248, from the owner) calls the deterministic deployer 0x4e59b44847b379578588920ca78fbf26c0b4956c (selector 0x9e593e54), so the creating frame is that deployer; Etherscan getcontractcreation names the owner as creator.

Reviewed loss. Source-1 receipt: yvWETH Transfer from 0x98289e90d6fc92a8769bc892d006a2baa7705afe to the executor of 384667252984919210375 (18 decimals), then burned by the vault withdraw. eth_call yvWETH pricePerShare() at block 24981716 = 1118358035811806430, so the stolen shares carry 430.1957134893375 WETH of book value; unit value = 1.118358035811806430 x WETH price (source-5). Net WETH flows in source-1: 0xcc9be930.. +429210570004163139903, executor -18 wei of pre-existing dust (balanceOf at block 24981716 = 18), so redemption proceeds were 429210570004163139885 wei.
